evidence_summary: Two reproducible cycles (REQ2/REQ6 and REQ4/REQ8) show collections/create accepting properties.collection.ttl.seconds=-100 with HTTP 200/code=0 while alter_properties on the same collection rejects the identical value with code=1100 (TTL out of range, expect [-1,3155760000]); describe (REQ3/REQ7) shows the TTL property never persisted.
rationale: Deterministic boundary violation of milvus_range_collections_create_004 (ttlSeconds>=0) and behavioral_002 (400 expected on invalid parameters), with an internal control proving the server enforces the exact range on the alter path, so the create-path silent acceptance is a clean illegal-success reproduction; maintainer 50351-style quick-create silent-ignore is a plausible by-design defense but does not negate the observed documented-contract breach.
